rendering_guidance.solid: dielectric plastic baseline; tune roughness/specular empirically
rendering_guidance.transparent: use VALUE plus ALPHA as catalog reference; physical transmission/IOR requires empirical profile
rendering_guidance.glitter: procedural inclusion/material effect; preserve material parameters when present
rendering_guidance.speckle: multi-component procedural material; preserve secondary material parameters

warning: LDraw rendering semantics are useful reference metadata, not a substitute for measured LEGO material optical properties.
